title: Nut, Seed and Raisin Trail Mix
summary: A simple American-style trail mix with crunchy nuts, toasty seeds, and sweet raisins. It’s a handy vegan snack for hikes, work, or a quick energy boost between meals.
steps: If the nuts and seeds are raw, toast the almonds, walnuts, pumpkin seeds, and sunflower seeds in a dry pan over medium heat for 4 to 6 minutes, stirring often, until fragrant and lightly golden. Let them cool completely.
Combine the cooled nuts and seeds with the raisins in a large bowl.
Sprinkle over the salt and cinnamon, then toss well so everything is evenly coated.
Store in an airtight container or portion into small snack bags.
